events.title: Demo Update - v0.4.1
events.summary: A new demo update is here.AddedAdded 6 new languages: Turkish, Spanish (Latin America), Spanish (Spain), Italian, Polish, and Dutch.Added Steam Cloud Save.Added Samurai Execution tutorial for the first attempt.ChangedAdjusted Skill Tree upgrade prices.FixedFixed the Helper Hand reappearing under certain conditions after enabling Hide Helper Hand.Thanks for playing Bottle Flip Inc and for all the feedback.

events.title: Thanks for 5,000 Wishlists!
events.summary: We've reached 5,000 wishlists for Bottle Flip Inc!Thank you so much to everyone who played the demo, wishlisted the game, shared it, and supported us. We're a small indie team of two, and every bit of support means a lot to us!Let's keep flipping!

events.title: Demo Update - v0.2.1
events.summary: Demo Update - v0.2.1We have pushed a couple of fixes and improvements:Fixed bottles becoming invisible after using certain skills.Added responsive UI support for different screen resolutions.Thank you for playing and reporting issues. Your feedback really helps us improve the game.

events.title: Demo Out Now!
events.summary: Hey everyone :)We’ve just released the Bottle Flip Inc Demo!The demo offers around 30 minutes of content, with up to 1 hour depending on how you play.We are happy to hear your feedback and are open for feature requests for the demo and especially the full game.Drop your thoughts in the Steam Discussions or join our Discord and come say hi!
